description_en: Applies a health check configuration template to a backend server group to update the health check configuration of the backend server group to the template values
description_zh: 将健康检查配置模板应用到后端服务器组，从而将后端服务器组的健康检查配置修改为模板值
name: ApplyHealthCheckTemplateToServerGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the health check template
parameters.name: health_check_template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backend server group
parameters.name: server_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: Prechecks the request without creating the resource. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): Sends a normal request. If the request passes the precheck, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

schema.description_en: The result of applying a health check template to a backend server group
schema.description_zh: 向后端服务器组应用健康检查模板

JobId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task
